Description: Faultlens website forms: HTTP API (API Gateway) -> Lambda -> Amazon SES email to the Faultlens inbox.

FromEmail.Description: Sender address. Must be verified in Amazon SES in this region (or its domain verified).

AllowedOrigins.Description: Website origins allowed to submit forms

Properties.Description: Validates Faultlens website form submissions and emails them via SES

FormEndpoint.Description: Set this as VITE_FORM_ENDPOINT in the website hosting environment
